concerns.text: T103 (consumer) requires validating 'feature/VIF report against contracts/feature_schema.yaml', but no task in the remaining plan PRODUCES an artifact conforming to that schema. T102 produces data/processed/feature_importance.csv (a two-column CSV), while feature_schema.yaml defines a JSON object with features[] {feature_name, importance_score, vif_score, is_excluded} plus a summary block. The completed T039a–T039c-3 produced vif_iteration_log.json, which is not stated to conform to feature_schema.yaml. Either add a producer task (e.g., emit a feature/VIF report JSON conforming to feature_schema.yaml, plausibly folded into T102) or point T103 at the artifact that actually exists; as written, T103 will fail or be vacuously skipped.
